meta.description: Concept (object/action) LoRA on Krea 2 Raw. EXTRAPOLATED — no published Krea concept recipe exists (LDS flags this too): rank 32 (Krea family canon) x concept alpha = rank/2, linear timesteps (Krea-canonical). Captions describe everything EXCEPT the concept. Steps: LDS computes 475*sqrt(images) clamped [2000,12000] — 3000 suits ~30-40 images. Speed (2026-08-29): latents are served from RAM after the first pass (cache_latents + cache_latents_to_disk — disk-only caching re-read every latent every step), loss_sync_every 4, ui_db_poll_seconds 2. Training math unchanged. STEP TABLE (meta.step_table, revised 2026-10-12): 20 images ~1500, 30 images ~1500, 50 images ~1600; above 50 images +20 steps/image with no hard cap (e.g. 100 images ~2600, 200 ~4600) - the exposure gauge judges sizes past the table against the arch exposure target and shows warm/hot if the run is getting long. Source: the Krea 2 tiered exposure target (45/32 steps/image) floored at 1500, last anchor at 50 images. Values are steps at effective batch 1 - the Step Suggestion panel and exposure gauge use this table while the preset is loaded and divide by your effective batch (batch_size x gradient_accumulation); below the first row the first row's steps apply.
